gloss: to help; to lend a hand

definitions.gloss: to help; to assist; to lend a hand
definitions.explanation: To provide practical assistance to someone who needs it. Implies hands-on, direct help rather than abstract support.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しを{手助|てだす}けする。
{困|こま}っている{人|ひと}を{手助|てだす}けしたい。
examples.english: I want to help people who are in trouble.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}の{人|ひと}たちが{復旧|ふっきゅう}{作業|さぎょう}を{手助|てだす}けしてくれた。
examples.english: The neighbors helped with the restoration work.

notes:
Formed from {手|て} (hand) + {助|たす}け (help), conveying the image of literally lending a hand. More concrete and action-oriented than abstract forms of assistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手助|てだす}けをする: to lend a hand (with を particle variant)
- {手助|てだす}けが{必要|ひつよう}: to need help
- {手助|てだす}けを{求|もと}める: to seek help
- ちょっとした{手助|てだす}け: a little bit of help

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手伝|てつだ}う: to help — the most common everyday word for helping
- {助|たす}ける: to save; to rescue — implies someone is in danger or serious difficulty
- {援助|えんじょ}する: to provide aid — formal; often used for institutional or international assistance
- サポートする: to support — loanword; often used in business and technology contexts
